name: boote
description: A reusable, context-free idea-incubator toolkit for Claude Code.

plugins.name: boote
plugins.description: Incubate a raw idea stage by stage like an experienced YC/Techstars mentor. Tracks each idea on a 7-rung validation ladder and gates progress on real user evidence: clarify, critique hard, run grounded deep research (Gemini), refine, build the financial model and economic verdict, name and brand it, produce a one-page memo and interactive HTML deck, log feedback, then graduate or park. Discovers and requires the host project's own context (strategy, principles, risks, hurdle) via `boote init` — no hardcoded company data.
